name: How long does a typical trim repair or replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical trim repair or replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a trim repair or replacement project varies significantly based on its scope. Minor repairs, such as filling a few nail holes or re-caulking, might take a few hours. Replacing trim in a single room could take one to two days, depending on the complexity of the trim profiles and the need for painting or finishing. A whole-house trim replacement, involving multiple rooms and exterior sections, could extend over several days to a week or more. Factors like material choice and existing surface conditions also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope: minor repairs take hours, a room takes days, and a whole-house replacement can take a week or more.
